belief_update: I believe that needing reassurance means I’m not as strong or capable as others, and that people would see me as a burden if they knew how much I rely on them. I think my coworkers and boyfriend would start treating me differently if they realized how unsure I am about even small things. I keep my anxiety and my need for validation hidden because I don’t want to be seen as weak or unreliable. I don’t believe I could ever live a normal, steady life without constantly checking in with someone else. I don’t let anyone see how much I struggle because I think it would make them doubt me. I feel like I’m already failing by needing so much from others, even if I don’t ask for it outright. I don’t know if I’m worth anything without their reassurance.
